text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice, City! Now, for the next one, I
want you
to relax...
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
That's it! A glimpse of the real you as
you spend
your day at school... That's
perfect!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to look over what we've
got so
far. You can all take a break!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text: Okay.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You too. It's not often you come along
with me to
my shoots. So, what do you
think?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Well, we are pros.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Although it feels a bit weird having a
shoot at the
school I go to every day.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It all started a few days ago. Голд Сити
asked me
for help getting permission to
do a photo shoot
at the academy.

It's for the magazine I'm a resident
model for.
They're doing a feature about
my debut.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So they want some photos showing me
at the
academy—you know, to get a
sense of my
everyday life.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'll contact the editor to have
them reach
out.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
If you're interested, you can come see
the shoot.
It's literally just taking
pictures, though.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I was interested to see what she's like at
work,
so... here I am.

Trainer! We really appreciate you setting
this all
up for us! Thanks to your help,
this is going to be
a great feature for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
I think your presence helped City relax
more than
normal, as well!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Trainer's got nothing to
do with
that—seriously.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You shot that down quick! Listen, I've
been
working with you since you were a
child, and I've
never seen you act so
kind and gentle before.
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
As a regular model for this magazine,
Gold City
seems to get along well with
all the staff at the
shoot.
But...
You're seriously amazing, City.
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: Huh? How so?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
To think you're already a successful
model, but
then you want to run in the
Twinkle Series on top
of that!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that unrelenting ambition of
yours is
the real key to your beauty.
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the editorial department
respects
you. Despite your popularity,
your self-discipline
keeps you striving to
improve yourself.
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But self improvement isn't
the reason
why I run.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I know. I haven't forgotten what you said
about
wanting to keep some distance
from your identity
as a model.
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
But that means you want to refine your
image
even further, right? It's almost like
you're a monk
seeking enlightenment!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll be able to use what you
gain from
racing to benefit you in the
future. I'm rooting for
you!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: That's not it. The reason why I run is...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
Never mind, I was just thinking about
your
compliment.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It made me... happy. Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Is it frustration or disappointment?
Perhaps she's
hurt that her serious
attempt at running is being
treated as a
mere accessory.

Realizing this, I decide I can't keep
quiet.
choice_data_list: I hope you'll pay attention to her running.

text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: The reason City runs is for the "now."

text_block_list.text: Um... Okay?
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff
choice_data_list:
You'll understand if you watch her race. So
please, come and watch!

text_block_list.text:
Um, of course, the editorial team is
going to
come, but...
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
Uh... let's resume shooting, shall we?
We're
cutting it a bit close for time. Are
you ready,
City?
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: Yes, I can go.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Okay. Trainer, please stay and watch!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text:
Did I... touch on something I shouldn't
have?
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: No...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Okay, good work today! Look forward to
its
printing in the magazine!
text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Staff

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about what you said during the
break...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: I should've minded my own business.

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you realize that. My coworkers
are all
really good people, so just be
careful.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: But I didn't want to see you forcing a smile.

text_block_list.text: So... you noticed.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I know they have nothing but good
intentions. I
know they genuinely
respect me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Considering my track record, it's only
natural they
consider racing as my side
hustle.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm already aware of all that, so I can do
without
the forced help.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Or at least, I should be able to. But you're right... it was shocking to hear.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Especially from someone who's been
around me
since I was little...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It's like they just don't know how I feel.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Then communicate it to them through your
running.

text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm trying to do. Don't need
you to
tell me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Still... you already get me, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Nothing. Let's go practice!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
